```{python}
#| label: fig-sequential-classes
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The bistable elements, sorted by how they react to a clock, with the German terms in gray. Latches are orange, the flip-flop is blue. The gate of the D latch is usually driven by a clock, so the difference to the flip-flop is not the clock, but whether the element reacts to its level or to its edge. The leaves name the cells of SG13CMOS5L, which has no SR latch."
#| fig-alt: "Tree diagram. The root bistable element, in German bistabile Kippstufe, branches into unclocked, ungetaktet, and clocked, taktgesteuert. Unclocked leads to the SR latch of two cross-coupled gates. Clocked branches into level-sensitive, taktzustandsgesteuert, and edge-triggered, taktflankengesteuert. Level-sensitive leads to the D latch, cell dlhq_1, and edge-triggered leads to the D flip-flop, cell dfrbpq_1. The two latches are orange, the flip-flop is blue."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow
from schemdraw import elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

BLUE, BLUE_L = '#6c8ebf', '#dae8fc'
ORANGE, ORANGE_L = '#d79b00', '#ffe6cc'
GREY = '#666666'
X0, X1, X2 = 0.0, 4.2, 8.4          # columns of the three leaves
XC = (X1 + X2)/2                     # clocked
XT = (X0 + XC)/2                     # root
Y0, Y1, Y2, Y3 = 0.0, -2.2, -4.4, -6.6
BW, BH = 3.6, 1.0                    # box
DY = 0.4                             # from a parent box down to its branch


def text(p, s, color='black', fontsize=11):
    ''' Text centered on p, with its capitals centered on p in y '''
    # A free Label sits 0.1 to the right of its anchor with its baseline on it, so shift it back.
    # theta(0): a label inherits the direction of the last wire, and its alignment turns with it.
    elm.Label().theta(0).at((p[0] - 0.1, p[1] - 0.1)).label(s, color=color, fontsize=fontsize)


def node(x, y, name, sub, fill='white', color=GREY):
    ''' Box with its name in black and a second line in gray '''
    flow.Box(w=BW, h=BH).at((x, y)).anchor('center').fill(fill).color(color)
    text((x, y + 0.19), name)
    text((x, y - 0.2), sub, color=GREY, fontsize=10)


def branch(x, y, xs, ys):
    ''' From the parent box at (x, y) to the child boxes at xs, all on row ys '''
    yb = y - BH/2 - DY
    if len(xs) == 1:
        flow.Arrow().at((x, y - BH/2)).to((x, ys + BH/2))
        return
    flow.Line().at((x, y - BH/2)).to((x, yb))
    elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at((x, yb))
    flow.Line().at((xs[0], yb)).to((xs[-1], yb))
    for xc in xs:
        flow.Arrow().at((xc, yb)).to((xc, ys + BH/2))


with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white', margin=0.2)
    node(XT, Y0, 'bistable element', 'bistabile Kippstufe')
    node(X0, Y1, 'unclocked', 'ungetaktet')
    node(XC, Y1, 'clocked', 'taktgesteuert')
    node(X1, Y2, 'level-sensitive', 'taktzustandsgesteuert')
    node(X2, Y2, 'edge-triggered', 'taktflankengesteuert')
    node(X0, Y3, 'SR latch', 'two cross-coupled gates', ORANGE_L, ORANGE)
    node(X1, Y3, 'D latch', 'dlhq_1', ORANGE_L, ORANGE)
    node(X2, Y3, 'D flip-flop', 'dfrbpq_1', BLUE_L, BLUE)
    branch(XT, Y0, [X0, XC], Y1)
    branch(XC, Y1, [X1, X2], Y2)
    branch(X0, Y1, [X0], Y3)
    branch(X1, Y2, [X1], Y3)
    branch(X2, Y2, [X2], Y3)
```
